disciplines.name: Smelting
disciplines.description: Smelting: judge local conditions, practise safe methods and pass reliable results to the next household.

Complete a seasonal cycle with at least 91 days of careful smelting (care ≥70%).
Three years of smelting; key attribute ≥12.

Learn smelting from a level-30 teacher, or gain an insight.
Ten years of smelting, an insight and key attribute ≥14.
